description: The external busy input is ORed into DCD: in LBT_WAIT it holds LBT_WAIT_TIMER like a burst, the channel is idle only once both the external input and DCD have cleared, and an idle the external input delays is DCD-determined, so the held timer restarts with lbt_wait_dcd_ms.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047); its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, U_PDU "hello", no confirmation) is data queued for transmission and produces no SIS output (A-0095, K-0096). The DTS keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue (C-1050). The channel is idle at 0, no transmission has been heard, so LBT rule 2 gives lbt_wait_dcd_ms, 30000 ms (K-0070). channel_busy true at 10000 is a busy indication (K-0006): csma.lbt_wait is held (K-0077, K-0087). The burst from 11000 to 13000 gives no EOT; its end clears DCD but the external input is still busy, so the channel stays busy (K-0073). The external input clears at 15000, after DCD, so the idle is DCD-determined (K-0006) and the held timer takes lbt_wait_dcd_ms (K-0120). At 45000 its expiry starts CONT_WAIT with the first draw of seed 0, uniform(16) = 15, so 45000 ms (K-0080, prng.md 5).
